commentPublished: Exceptional perspective on digital health transformation, Cris. Reducing clinical cognitive load through sub-second telemetry and seamless FHIR interoperability remains essential for high-acuity care teams.

title: Chief Digital & Information Officer
commentPublished: Spot-on insight, Craig. Aligning modern clinical telemetry with open EHR architectures is critical to breaking down acute care data silos without exorbitant vendor lock-in.

title: Chief Executive @ eHealth NSW & CIO @ NSW Health
commentPublished: Compelling perspective on enterprise health data mobilization, Zoran. Eliminating clinical waveform silos and bridging acute care telemetry with FHIR pipelines remains crucial for statewide interoperability.

title: Chief Information Officer (CIO) & Head of IT Management
commentPublished: Herzlichen Glückwunsch zur Zertifizierung als AI Automation Manager, Michael! Die Verbindung von fundierter Regulatorik und praktischer KI-Umsetzung im Maschinenraum ist genau der Schlüssel für sichere und nachhaltige Innovation. Großartige Leistung!

title: Managing Director & Healthcare Technology Leader
commentPublished: Ein sehr spannendes Konferenzthema, Christian! Der technologische Wandel und die digitale Transformation bieten enormes Potenzial für zukunftsfähige und nachhaltige Stadtentwicklung. Viel Erfolg bei der FUTURE CITY REGIONS 2026!

title: Chief Information and Technology Officer (CITO)
hospital: Overlake Medical Center & Clinics / MultiCare Health System
commentPublished: Outstanding leadership in clinical technology, Scott. Creating seamless, sub-second telemetry feeds directly into Epic workflows without locking health systems into rigid vendor silos is essential for acute care resilience.

title: Chief Information Officer & Chief Human Resources Officer
commentPublished: Fantastic perspective, Shea. Bridging clinical IT with workforce well-being by streamlining ICU data flows and reducing alarm fatigue is transformative for frontline healthcare teams.

title: Chief Information Officer (CIO)
commentPublished: Spot-on perspective, Kristin. Equipping acute care clinicians with real-time waveform feeds and zero-friction Epic integration is critical to streamlining clinical workflows and patient outcomes.

title: SVP & Chief Information Digital Officer
commentPublished: Compelling insight on regional healthcare technology leadership, Glen. Breaking down acute care telemetry silos and unifying multi-facility clinical data streams is essential for operational resilience.

title: Chief Information Officer & CISO
commentPublished: Outstanding focus on critical access clinical systems, Jeff. Ensuring robust cybersecurity while maintaining zero-latency bedside telemetry is foundational for community health systems.

title: EVP, Chief Digital & Info Officer & Dean of IT
commentPublished: Inspiring digital health leadership, Lisa. Fostering seamless interoperability and reducing clinical friction through sub-second telemetry is key to empowering frontline care teams across complex health systems.

title: Group SVP & Chief Information and Transformation Officer (CITO)
commentPublished: Outstanding vision on clinical transformation, Dr. Fleischut. Integrating real-time physiological telemetry with modern EHR pipelines without vendor lock-in represents the gold standard for high-acuity patient care.

title: SVP & Chief Information Officer
commentPublished: Spot-on perspective on health IT scalability, Craig. Unifying ICU data streams into open, low-latency FHIR architectures is essential for clinical excellence and physician retention.

title: Chief Information Officer / Deputy Director-General
commentPublished: Commendable progress on digital health infrastructure, Damian. Ensuring secure, enterprise-grade interoperability across regional clinical networks is a massive win for patient outcomes.
